title: SigningKeyInfo
description: A trusted signing key and its lifecycle metadata — mirrors the pinned drenyra-ai@0.2.0 SigningKeyInfo shape field-for-field (REQ-CONTRACTS-005; design §6.1). Dates are canonical ISO-8601 instants; lifecycle order (issuedAt <= expiresAt/revokedAt) is enforced at trust time.

publicKey.description: base64-encoded Ed25519 public key; private keys are never stored in this registry
